declared.summary: Independently qualify the exact original F35 Numerics NuGet archive with a fresh package-only binary consumer, fifteen compiled probes and pinned IR/Quantities dependencies without shared publication.
declared.value: Build and install the original F35 binary consumer through repeatable source-only preflight. Verify the exact 18313-byte original, fresh NuGet cache, loaded DLL SHA-256, fifteen compiled oracles and unchanged IR/Quantities through a focused post-attempt validation; retain the actual JSON output in the DWF report.
debtChanges: RS170 succeeded in attempt 001 but had one pre-attempt CS7036 refusal; its F37 proof verified physical original F35 archive bytes and withheld release authorization.
F36 reconstructed Numerics bytes differ from the immutable original F35; RS171 consumes only exact F35 bytes without rebuilding or substituting a rehearsal package.
RS171 writes no NuGet package to NUGET_LOCAL, makes no public license decision, qualifies no installed rollback and modifies no sibling repositories or AURA D3.

RS171 preselection retry 1 corrects a preparation-only failure: DWF's disposable Git clone excludes the ignored F35 archive. The physical consumer now runs only after attempt allocation and no synthetic F38 receipt is written.

RS171 preselection retry 2 addresses CS8321: after F38 source/physical separation, the source-only validator retained an unused Sha helper. Removing the dead function leaves physical F35 verification in focused post-attempt validation.
declared.nextAction: After the focused F38 validation succeeds in the durable RS171 report, independently reconcile its observed hashes and binary outcomes; private publication of original F35 bytes still requires explicit owner authorization.
